method.reason: Use the widely available B3LYP hybrid functional for geometry optimization and frequency analysis of neutral singlet ethanol; the official ORCA manual documents its exchange-correlation definition and parametrization, while final scientific validity remains checked by ORCA execution.

sources.quote: The popular B3LYP functional (20% HF exchange) as defined in the TurboMole program system (LDAOPT C_VWN5)

basis.reason: Choose the polarized valence triple-zeta def2-TZVP orbital basis, which is documented for first-row organic elements and is suitable for ethanol geometry optimization and vibrational frequencies under the available resources.

sources.quote: The Karlsruhe def2-TZVP basis set can be invoked via the def2-TZVP keyword.

proposal.reason: The Request leaves method and basis for automatic selection. Existing current-Run official ORCA knowledge results support choosing B3LYP and def2-TZVP; selection is documented but does not itself establish scientific qualification.
